ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

badge.note: Counts above max render as "{max}+" with the full value in the title tooltip. Zero hides the counter unless showZero is set.

avatar.description: Identity block with photo, generative initials, presence, counts, group, and profile.

examples.note: Start with real photos (remote URLs with graceful generative fallback), then the generative fallback and the empty placeholder. Grow the group with the dashed add button — members live in memory only and reset on reload.

group.note: Groups overlap members and truncate with a focusable +N pill that opens a consumer menu. Hover for the member tooltip; navigate with the arrow keys and activate with Enter.

group-badge.note: A pill with a mini member cluster and a text label. The +N marker is static text, so the pill itself can be a link or a button.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the family.

integrations.note: Avatars never implement overlays: hover the avatar for a reused tooltip, and open the group member list through a consumer dropdown menu. The +N pill stays keyboard-focusable.

overlays.note: Verified, organization, and action markers reuse slots — tooltips and menus come from the consumer.

profile.note: Profiles pair identity with title, subtitle, and an optional badge. Compact mode renders the avatar only.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

size-radius.note: Sizes are fixed in px; radius follows the host, including every marker.

states.note: Active renders a continuous ring; loading renders an animated arc that stops under reduced motion.

status.note: The dot renders per status. Force off-hours to preview the z emblem without changing the status color.

avatar.title: Avatar
